info.title: CODM Beast Studio API
info.description: Automatic CODM montage editor: upload gameplay, auto-edit, preview and export. Set BEAST_API_TOKEN to require `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on every /api call.

post.summary: Upload one or more media files

get.summary: List media (yours plus the built-in library)

schema.title: Response List Media Api Media Get

patch.summary: Rename or move to a folder

get.summary: Stream the original file (supports Range for seeking)
A still frame from a video at time t (seconds)

schema.title: Response List Projects Api Projects Get

patch.summary: Rename, change media, or change settings

delete.summary: Delete a project and its exports

post.summary: Replace style settings with a preset (keeps music, titles and export choices)

schema.title: Response Revisions Api Projects  Project Id  Revisions Get

get.summary: Detected highlight candidates, scene cuts and quiet sections

schema.title: Response Highlights Api Projects  Project Id  Highlights Get

post.summary: Analyse footage, build a montage timeline and (by default) render it
Render the current timeline (preview=true for a fast low-res preview)
Before/after still frames using the project's real FFmpeg grade

schema.title: Response Compare Api Projects  Project Id  Compare Post

post.summary: One click: new project from media, auto-edit and render

schema.title: Response List Jobs Api Jobs Get

post.summary: Run a failed or cancelled job again

schema.title: Response List Exports Api Exports Get

post.summary: Measure an image and suggest Auto Enhance settings

schema.title: Response Analyze Api Images  Media Id  Analyze Post

post.summary: Render an edit and return a JPEG preview (not saved)
Render an edit at full size and save it (PNG or JPEG)

schema.title: Response Render Image Api Images  Media Id  Render Post

post.summary: Add a screenshot to a project's montage as a timed scene

schema.title: Response Cleanup Api System Cleanup Post
